patterns: APPSC asks single-fact items: crust-mantle boundary = Moho, direct source = surface rock from mining, core = iron (+nickel, silicon as extra).
Discontinuity naming (Conrad/Moho/Repetti/Gutenberg/Lehmann) is the recurring trap; options mix all four.
Crustal abundance (O > Si > Al > Fe) and NIFE/SIAL/SIMA expansions recur across PSCs.
Many PYQs filed here are general science (inertia, hydrometer, rusting) - the real interior-of-earth pool is small.
App MCQs lean on multi-statement and match formats and current research news (Swarm, delamination, mantle quakes) that APPSC does not ask.
